name: Electrocute
description: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3 seconds deals bonus adaptive damage.

name: Dark Harvest
description: Damaging a low-health champion deals bonus adaptive damage and harvests a soul, permanently increasing this damage.

name: Empowerment
description: After using an ability, your next basic attack is enhanced with bonus adaptive damage.

name: Lethal Tempo
description: Attacking a champion grants stacking attack speed. At max stacks, you also gain bonus attack range.

name: Fleet Footwork
description: Moving and attacking builds energy stacks. At full stacks, your next attack heals you and grants bonus movement speed.

name: Conqueror
description: Attacks and abilities on champions grant stacking adaptive force. At max stacks, you also heal for a portion of damage dealt.

name: Grasp of the Undying
description: Every 3 seconds in combat, your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you, and permanently increases your max health.

name: Guardian
description: When nearby allied champions take damage, both you and the ally gain a shield and bonus movement speed.

name: Aery
description: Damaging a champion sends Aery to them dealing bonus damage. Shielding or buffing an ally sends Aery to shield them instead.

name: Arcane Comet
description: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing bonus adaptive damage.

name: Phase Rush
description: Hitting a champion with 3 attacks or abilities within 3 seconds grants a burst of movement speed and slow resistance.

name: First Strike
description: If you damage a champion before they damage you, gain bonus gold and deal increased damage for a short duration.

name: Ice Overlord
description: Immobilizing a champion deals bonus magic damage to them and nearby enemies. Also grants bonus resistances temporarily.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Deal bonus true damage to champions with impaired movement or actions (slowed, stunned, rooted, etc.).

name: Sudden Impact
description: After using a dash, blink, or leaving stealth, gain bonus armor penetration and magic penetration for a few seconds.

name: Empowered Attack
description: Your first basic attack against each champion deals bonus adaptive damage.

name: Chain Assault
description: After scoring a takedown, your next attack or ability on a different champion deals bonus damage.

name: Tyrant
description: Deal bonus damage to champions who have more max health than you.

name: Hubris
description: Gain adaptive force on champion takedowns. Stacks up to a cap and partially lost on death.

name: Eyeball Collection
description: Collect eyeballs on champion takedowns. Each eyeball grants adaptive force, up to a cap.

name: Ingenious Hunter
description: Gain item ability haste. Unique champion takedowns grant additional item ability haste, stacking up.

name: Relentless Hunter
description: Gain bonus out-of-combat movement speed. Unique champion takedowns grant additional speed, stacking up.

name: Zombie Ward
description: Destroying enemy wards creates a friendly Zombie Ward in its place. Zombie Wards grant vision and earn adaptive force.

name: Brutal
description: Gain bonus adaptive force and armor/magic penetration.

name: Triumph
description: Champion takedowns restore a portion of your missing health and grant bonus gold.

name: Battle Zeal
description: Gain bonus attack speed after hitting a champion with an ability. Stacks on repeated hits.

name: Last Stand
description: Deal increased damage when you are low on health. The lower your health, the more bonus damage you deal.

name: Cut Down
description: Deal bonus damage to champions who have more max health than you. The difference in health increases the bonus.

name: Coup de Grace
description: Deal increased damage to champions who are below a health threshold.

name: Legend: Alacrity
description: Gain bonus attack speed on champion takedowns and large monster kills, stacking permanently.

name: Legend: Tenacity
description: Gain bonus tenacity (crowd control duration reduction) on champion takedowns and large monster kills, stacking permanently.

name: Legend: Bloodline
description: Gain bonus physical vamp on champion takedowns and large monster kills, stacking permanently.

name: Demolish
description: Charge up a powerful attack against towers over a few seconds while near them. The empowered attack deals bonus physical damage based on your max health.

name: Font of Life
description: Impairing the movement of an enemy champion marks them. Allied champions who attack marked enemies heal over time.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: When you immobilize an enemy champion, gain a shield that scales with your max health and the number of nearby enemies.

name: Unshakeable
description: Gain bonus tenacity and slow resistance. When immobilized, briefly gain additional resistances.

name: Second Wind
description: After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate a portion of your missing health over several seconds.

name: Nullifying Orb
description: When you take magic damage that would bring you below a health threshold, gain a magic damage shield.

name: Bone Plating
description: After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next three instances of damage from them are reduced.

name: Overgrowth
description: Absorb life essence from nearby dying minions and monsters, permanently gaining bonus max health.

name: Revitalize
description: Heals and shields you cast and receive are increased. This bonus is enhanced on low-health targets.

name: Perseverance
description: Gain bonus armor and magic resistance that increases when you are low on health.

name: Axiom Arcanist
description: Gain bonus ability haste. Champion takedowns further reduce your remaining ultimate cooldown.

name: Manaflow Band
description: Hitting a champion with an ability permanently increases your max mana. At max stacks, restore missing mana periodically.

name: Botanist
description: Enhance nearby honey fruits, increasing their healing and providing additional effects when consumed.

name: Hexflash
description: While Flash is on cooldown, you can channel to cast a shorter-range Hexflash instead.

name: Transcendence
description: Gain bonus ability haste at certain level breakpoints. Champion takedowns reduce remaining ability cooldowns.

name: Celerity
description: Gain bonus movement speed. All movement speed bonuses you receive are increased by a percentage.

name: Absolute Focus
description: Gain bonus adaptive force while above a health threshold.

name: Scorch
description: Your next ability hit on a champion sets them ablaze, dealing bonus magic damage over time. Has a short cooldown.

name: Nimbus Cloak
description: After casting a summoner spell, gain a burst of bonus movement speed that decays over a few seconds.

name: Gathering Storm
description: Gain increasing amounts of adaptive force over the course of the game at set time intervals.

name: Ixtali Seedjar
description: Periodically gain a seed that can be planted as a ward. Seeds grant brief vision in the planted area.
